text:
Maya: Heads-up — we have a 2:05pm walk-in and the kiosk printed their badge but the photo is super fuzzy. Front desk tried to reprint and the sticker sheet jammed. Lobby couches are full. Anyone near the desk who can help?
Andre: can the admin portal reissue a badge? iirc there's a 'reprint badge' button in the People Ops view.
Maya: Front desk says they don't have the portal creds on that machine and kiosk is stuck on the print screen.
Jordan: On it — paging security to hold the visitor at reception. @Mel can you check label-printer-1?
Mel: label-printer-1 (Zebra ZT230) showed a low-ribbon warning earlier. I'm nearby, swapping ribbon now. ETA ~8m.
frontdesk-bot: Visitor check-in: "Guest: Sam Patel" logged at 14:03. Waiting at Reception.
Ravi: If seating gets tight, we can free up the north lounge (two chairs) — leaving a sticky note so the product team knows. :thumbsup:
Lina: I have an extra lanyard and a spare clear badge sleeve in my bag, bringing to the desk.
Maya: Awesome — reprint succeeded after ribbon swap and manual feed. Visitor escorted to Conf Rm B. Leaving a note to replace ribbon cartridges in inventory. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
